steps.eval: (() => { const c = pokewatch.ctx, H = c.world.hab; c.player.x = c.player.px = H.contest.x - c.world.half; c.player.z = c.player.pz = H.contest.y - c.world.half; c.player.y = c.player.py = c.world.height(c.player.x, c.player.z); return [H.recipe, H.seed, H.gates.filter((g) => !g.ok).length, c.world.tideHigh]; })()

(() => { const c = pokewatch.ctx, W = c.world, H = W.hab, D = W.tide; const ax = H.stage.A[0] + (H.contest.x - H.stage.A[0]) * 0.4, ay = H.stage.A[1] + (H.contest.y - H.stage.A[1]) * 0.4; let best = -1, bd = 1e9; for (let i = 0; i < D.tiles.length; i++) { if (D.terrain[i] === 3) continue; const k = D.tiles[i], d = Math.hypot((k % W.w) + 0.5 - ax, ((k / W.w) | 0) + 0.5 - ay); if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = k; } } c.player.x = c.player.px = (best % W.w) - W.half + 0.5; c.player.z = c.player.pz = ((best / W.w) | 0) - W.half + 0.5; c.player.y = c.player.py = W.height(c.player.x, c.player.z); return [H.recipe, H.seed, best % W.w, (best / W.w) | 0, W.tideHigh]; })()
